init_AllScAIPConfigs_from_kwargs: use init_configs with AllScAIPConfigs and a flat kwargs dict to build the full nested config object
init_GlobalConfigs_from_kwargs: use init_configs with GlobalConfigs and a kwargs dict to create model global settings like hidden_size and num_layers
init_MolecularGraphConfigs_from_kwargs: use init_configs with MolecularGraphConfigs and a kwargs dict to create molecular graph settings like max_atoms and knn_k
init_GraphNeuralNetworksConfigs_from_kwa: use init_configs with GraphNeuralNetworksConfigs and a kwargs dict to create GNN settings like atten_num_heads and expansion sizes
resolve_type_hint_forward_refs: use resolve_type_hint to convert string forward reference type hints into actual class objects for a dataclass field
